title: Indic-TunedLens: Interpreting Multilingual Models in Indian Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating layer-wise accuracy, prediction entropy, and the average rank of correct tokens from intermediate model layers across 10 Indian languages and English using interpretability frameworks (Logit Lens vs. Indic-TunedLens) on the MMLU benchmark to demonstrate the presence of English-centric representation spaces in multilingual models.
